title: Implement route POST /api/trainers/{trainer_id}/badges
diff: +        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="only a gym leader awards badges")

segments.title: New add_badge route, award_badge, require_gym_leader and badge schemas, modified app

traceDiagram.title: Award badge request flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the badges router [registers `POST /api/trainers/{trainer_id}/badges`](code:src/pokedex/badges/routes.py#L11). It also shows what happens when a request reaches that route, and how the new badge [reaches the in-memory `trainers` store](code:src/pokedex/badges/service.py#L7) through `award_badge()`.

traceNodes.label: Awards a badge to one trainer
traceNodes.description: When a client sends `POST /api/trainers/{trainer_id}/badges`, FastAPI runs `verify_api_key()`, which [`main.py` adds to every route of the badges router](code:src/pokedex/main.py#L16). Then FastAPI runs [`require_gym_leader()` from the dependencies of the route](code:src/pokedex/badges/routes.py#L11) and calls the handler.

children.label: Adds the badge of the body to the trainer of the path
children.description: When a client sends `POST /api/trainers/{trainer_id}/badges`, FastAPI [parses the body as `BadgeAward`](code:src/pokedex/badges/routes.py#L12). FastAPI also [loads the trainer of the path through `TrainerDep`](code:src/pokedex/trainers/dependencies.py#L13), then calls this handler and [returns its result as `TrainerBadges` with a 201](code:src/pokedex/badges/routes.py#L11).

blockLabels.label: Returns the trainer with the new badge
Calls award_badge to give the badge of the body to the trainer

traceNodes.label: Puts /trainers/{trainer_id}/badges before every route of the file
traceNodes.description: When a client sends `POST /api/trainers/{trainer_id}/badges`, FastAPI matches the path below the prefix of this router. [`main.py` mounts this router under `/api`](code:src/pokedex/main.py#L16).

traceNodes.label: Appends the badge and saves the trainer in the store
traceNodes.description: When a client sends `POST /api/trainers/{trainer_id}/badges`, [`add_badge()` calls this function](code:src/pokedex/badges/routes.py#L13) with the trainer of the path and the badge of the body.

blockLabels.label: Returns the trainer with the new badge

traceNodes.label: Parses and checks the body of an award request
traceNodes.description: When a client sends `POST /api/trainers/{trainer_id}/badges`, FastAPI [parses the request body into this model](code:src/pokedex/badges/routes.py#L12) before it calls `add_badge()`. FastAPI returns a 422 when `badge` is empty or longer than 30 characters.

blockLabels.label: Checks that the badge has 1 to 30 characters

traceNodes.label: Builds the response body from the awarded trainer
traceNodes.description: When `add_badge()` returns, FastAPI [validates the result against this model](code:src/pokedex/badges/routes.py#L11), because the route names it as its `response_model`. The response therefore holds the id, the name and the badges of the trainer, and leaves out `hometown`.

blockLabels.label: Keeps the id of the trainer
Keeps the name of the trainer
Keeps every badge of the trainer

traceNodes.label: Returns a 403 for a header that names no gym leader
traceNodes.description: When a client sends `POST /api/trainers/{trainer_id}/badges`, FastAPI calls this dependency before the handler, because [the route lists it in its `dependencies`](code:src/pokedex/badges/routes.py#L11). FastAPI reads `x_gym_leader` from the `x-gym-leader` header of the request.

blockLabels.label: Raises an HTTPException when the header names no gym leader
Returns the name of the gym leader
